role: independent numerical perfect-gas similarity solution; not measurements
equations: (C g'/Pr)' + f g' + (gamma-1) Me^2 C f''^2 = 0
coordinate: z: dy sqrt(Re_x)/x = sqrt(2) g dz; Blasius eta=sqrt(2) z
boundary_conditions: f(0)=f'(0)=0; f'(infinity)=g(infinity)=1; g'(0)=0 adiabatic or g(0)=Tw/Te isothermal
normalization: Re_x=rho_e U_e x/mu_e; cf uses edge dynamic pressure; delta99 at u/Ue=0.99; delta* and theta integrated to infinity
wall_temperature: Tw/Taw uses the solved adiabatic temperature; ratio 1 uses zero heat flux, not sqrt(Pr) recovery

numerics.quadrature: adaptive quad, epsabs=epsrel=1e-10; brentq for u/Ue=0.99

limitations: constant cp and Pr, perfect gas, ZPG, no viscous interaction; high-temperature rows are mathematical checks, not real-gas validation
